machine_type: <str> Machine environment: 'identical' (same speed), 'uniform' (speed factors), or 'unrelated' (independent times).
num_jobs: <int> Total number of jobs to be scheduled.
num_machines: <int> Total number of parallel machines available.
congestion_parameter_q: <int or null> Controls the tightness of due dates for the tardy-jobs variant; null for the completion-time variant.

machines.speeds: <list[int], length num_machines, or null> Speed factor of each machine for uniform machines; null for identical or unrelated machines.

jobs.weights: <list[int], length num_jobs> Priority weight of each job, used in the objective function.
jobs.processing_times: <list[list[int]], shape [num_jobs][num_machines]> Time required to process each job on each machine.
jobs.base_processing_times: <list[int], length num_jobs, or null> Inherent processing time of each job before applying machine speed factors; null for unrelated machines.
jobs.due_dates: <list[int], length num_jobs, or null> Deadline by which each job should be completed for the tardy-jobs variant; null for the completion-time variant.
